title: episod/granite-4.0-h-1b-blackhole — numbers (from the model card)
aria: From the model card, on one Blackhole p300c chip with tt-metal v0.80.0: about 34 tokens per second traced decode, 0.32 seconds to the first token after a short prompt, 123, 406 and 651 tokens per second prefill for prompts of 128, 512 and 1,024 tokens, and top-1 agreement with the fp32 CPU reference of 0.979 on four short prompts.

lines.t: one Blackhole p300c chip, tt-metal v0.80.0
time to the first token, short prompt
top-1 agreement with the fp32 CPU reference, 4 prompts
36 Mamba-2 layers and 4 attention layers; one request at a time
